g.text: Pin numbers are that page's own, viewed looking into the console socket (so a plug is the mirror).

g.desc: Pin numbers are that page's own, viewed looking into the console socket (so a plug is the mirror).

g.text: 1 yellow: 5 V supply (used by the rumble motor)

g.desc: 1 yellow: 5 V supply (used by the rumble motor)

g.text: 2 red: DATA, bidirectional, pull-up to 3.43 V

g.desc: 2 red: DATA, bidirectional, pull-up to 3.43 V

g.text: 3 green: ground 4 white: ground (Skillz adapter ties 3 and 4 together)

g.desc: 3 green: ground 4 white: ground (Skillz adapter ties 3 and 4 together)

g.text: 5: not connected by the official controller

g.desc: 5: not connected by the official controller

g.text: 6 blue: 3.43 V logic supply (page measured 3.43 V on a PAL console; calls 3.3 V a likely fine choice)

g.desc: 6 blue: 3.43 V logic supply (page measured 3.43 V on a PAL console; calls 3.3 V a likely fine choice)

g.text: The page's own caveat: pinout is deduced from multimeter and oscilloscope work, no guarantee.
